title: Fling all PC ONLY
features: Press "Q" and spectate how everyone get sky!
script:
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer

game.Players.LocalPlayer:GetMouse().KeyDown:Connect(function(key)
    if key == 'q' then
        local diamond = player.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Diamond") or player.Character:FindFirstChild("Diamond")
        if diamond and diamond:FindFirstChild("Event") then
            for _, targetPlayer in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if targetPlayer ~= player and targetPlayer.Character then
                    local targetCharacter = targetPlayer.Character
                    local targetHumanoid = targetCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    
                    if targetHumanoid then
                        local forceVector = Vector3.new(0, 93131231291293, 0)
                        diamond.Event:FireServer("slash", targetCharacter, forceVector)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)
